description: Advisories npm audit reports on the runtime dependencies of the desktop UI that are accepted, each with the reason it cannot reach Apollia and the condition that lifts it. scripts/check_npm_audit.py fails on any advisory not listed here, whatever its severity, and names an entry no longer encountered.

advisories.reason: Prototype poisoning through mergeObject() needs attacker-controlled input to merge. svelte-i18n calls deepmerge only in addMessages (dist/runtime.js), and the interface feeds it nothing but the two catalogues bundled with the application, en.json and fr.json (src/lib/i18n/index.ts). No version of deepmerge carries a fix.
advisories.lift: a fixed deepmerge, or a svelte-i18n that no longer depends on it
